151-3488-5261.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-3488-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-3488-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Katsumasa.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

2021-2060-5902-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2021-2060-5902-7803.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

5189-5231-5439-7824.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
5189-5231-5439-7824.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {R}.
Repeat.

280-282-1479.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Delina (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Golgari Rot Farm onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Golgari Rot Farm trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1308-2457-4289-7730.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

215-4010-5434-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-5434-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

4381-5256--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

186-575-5971-7097.notablePrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
186-575-5971-7097.description:
Activate Yavimaya Elder by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Yavimaya Elder dies, it and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder trigger, allowing you to search your library for up to two basic land cards and put them into your hand.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning Yavimaya Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Yavimaya Elder enters, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yavimaya Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Yavimaya Elder face-up.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1682-2366-4068-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1682-2366-4068-5702.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1682-2366-4068-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-1492-2423.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-2423.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Welding Jar.
Cast Welding Jar from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Bounding Krasis.
When Bounding Krasis enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4053-5256-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2034-2557-5220-5477-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2557-5220-5477-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating two creature tokens and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

339-677-1753-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1849-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
1849-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

2084-3504.notablePrerequisites: Mercurial Pretender is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-3504.description: Activate Mercurial Pretender by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Mercurial Pretender into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

230-2713-4050-4666.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-2713-4050-4666.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
Planar Void triggers, exiling the card put into the graveyard.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {G}.
Repeat.

719-914-1327-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
Cleaver Skaab does not have summoning sickness.
"Zombie" chosen with Xenograft.
719-914-1327-2178.description:
Activate Cleaver Skaab by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Cleaver Skaab, untapping Cleaver Skaab.
Resolve the Cleaver Skaab ability from step 1, creating two token copies of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist tokens enter the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

628-793-1636-2838-5173.notablePrerequisites: Soul Diviner does not have summoning sickness.
628-793-1636-2838-5173.description:
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
Shambling Ghast triggers, creating a treasure token.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Sorched Rusalka trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Soul Diviner by tapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from Shambling Ghast.
Repeat.
